en: it is deeply meaningful to be here with Carnegie Mellon.
zh: 能来到卡内基梅隆大学，与大家在一起，我深感意义非凡。

en: one of the world's great universities and one of the rare places.
zh: 这里是世界顶尖大学之一，也是少数几个

en: that invents the future.
zh: 真正发明未来的地方之一。

en: Today is a day of pride and joy, a dream come true for you,
zh: 今天是一个充满骄傲与喜悦的日子，是你们梦想成真的一天，

en: but not only for you.
zh: 但这一天不只属于你们。

en: Your families, teachers, mentors, and friends help carry you here.
zh: 你们的家人、老师、导师和朋友一路支持着你们走到这里。

en: Before we talk about the future, thank them.
zh: 在我们谈论未来之前，请先感谢他们。

en: This day belongs to them too.
zh: 这一天也属于他们。

en: Graduates, please stand up, stand with me.
zh: 毕业生们，请站起来，和我一起站起来。

en: Come on, you guys.
zh: 来吧，各位。

en: Especially, turn to your mothers and wish them a happy Mother's Day.
zh: 特别是，请转向你们的母亲，祝她们母亲节快乐。

en: For you, this is another step in your life.
zh: 对你们来说，这是人生中的又一步。

en: but for her, this is a dream come true.
zh: 但对她来说，这是梦想成真的时刻。

en: Please sit down. CMU students like robots take instructions one at a time.
zh: 请坐下。卡内基梅隆的学生就像机器人一样，一次只执行一个指令。

en: To see your graduate, to see you...
zh: 看到自己的孩子毕业，看到你们……

en: Okay, everybody, focus. I have something important to tell you.
zh: 好了，各位，集中注意力。我有重要的话要告诉你们。

en: To see you graduate from one of the world's great institutions, this is her moment too.
zh: 看到自己的孩子从世界顶尖学府之一毕业，这也是她的高光时刻。

en: My mom and dad are deeply proud of me as well.
zh: 我的父母也为我深感骄傲。

en: My journey is their journey.
zh: 我的人生旅程，也是他们的人生旅程。

en: I am their dream come true.
zh: 我就是他们梦想成真的结果。

en: And their dream was the American dream.
zh: 而他们的梦想，就是美国梦。

en: Like many in this audience, I'm a first-generation immigrant.
zh: 和在座许多人一样，我是第一代移民。

en: My father had a dream to raise his family in America.
zh: 我的父亲曾梦想在美国养育他的家庭。

en: When I was nine years old.
zh: 我九岁那年。

en: he sent my older brother and me to the United States.
zh: 他把我和哥哥送到了美国。

en: We ended up at a Baptist boarding school in Oneida, Kentucky, coal country,
zh: 我们最后来到肯塔基州奥奈达的一所浸礼会寄宿学校，那是在煤矿地区，

en: a town of a few hundred people.
zh: 一个只有几百人的小镇。

en: Two years later, my parents left everything behind to join us.
zh: 两年后，我的父母放下一切，来到美国与我们团聚。

en: They came with little to nothing.
zh: 他们几乎是一无所有地来到这里。

en: My father was a chemical engineer.
zh: 我的父亲是一名化学工程师。

en: My mother worked as a maid at a Catholic school.
zh: 我的母亲在一所天主教学校做女佣。

en: She woke me up at 4 AM in the morning to deliver newspapers.
zh: 她会在凌晨四点叫醒我去送报纸。

en: My older brother got me a job as a dishwasher at Denny's,
zh: 我的哥哥帮我在丹尼餐厅找了一份洗碗工的工作，

en: which at the time felt like a major career advancement.
zh: 在当时，那对我来说简直是一次重大的职业晋升。

en: That was my view of America.
zh: 那就是我眼中的美国。

en: Not easy, but full of opportunities.
zh: 并不容易，但充满机会。

en: Not a guarantee, but a chance.
zh: 不是一种保证，而是一次机会。

en: My parents came here because they believed America could give their children a chance.
zh: 我的父母来到这里，是因为他们相信美国能给他们的孩子一个机会。

en: How can we not be romantic about America?
zh: 我们怎么可能不对美国怀有浪漫情怀呢？

en: I went to Oregon State University.
zh: 我上了俄勒冈州立大学。

en: I met my wife, Lori, when I was 17 years old.
zh: 我17岁时遇到了我的妻子洛丽。

en: I was the youngest kid in school.
zh: 我是学校里年龄最小的孩子。

en: We were sophomore lab partners.
zh: 我们是大二的实验课搭档。

en: She was 19. An older woman.
zh: 她19岁。是个年长的女人。

en: I beat out 250 other boys in class and won her heart.
zh: 我打败了班上其他250个男生，赢得了她的心。

en: We've now been married for 40 years.
zh: 如今我们已经结婚40年了。

en: We have two amazing children, both working at NVIDIA.
zh: 我们有两个非常优秀的孩子，他们都在英伟达工作。

en: When I was 30, I started NVIDIA with Chris Malachowski and Curtis Pring,
zh: 我30岁时，和克里斯·马拉科夫斯基、柯蒂斯·普里姆一起创办了英伟达，

en: two amazing computer scientists.
zh: 他们是两位非常出色的计算机科学家。

en: We wanted to build a new kind of computer.
zh: 我们想打造一种全新的计算机。

en: one that could solve problems ordinary computers could not.
zh: 一种能够解决普通计算机无法解决的问题的计算机。

en: We had absolutely no idea how to build a company, raise money,
zh: 我们完全不知道该如何创办公司、如何融资，

en: or run NVIDIA. I just thought, how hard could it be?
zh: 也不知道该如何经营英伟达。我当时只是想，这能有多难呢？

en: It turns out, it is super hard.
zh: 结果证明，真的超级难。

en: Our first technology didn't even work.
zh: 我们的第一项技术甚至根本行不通。

en: We nearly ran out of money.
zh: 我们几乎把钱花光了。

en: At one point, I had to fly to Japan and explain to Sega's CEO
zh: 有一次，我不得不飞到日本，向Sega的CEO解释，

en: that the technology they contracted us to build would not work.
zh: 他们签约让我们开发的那项技术是行不通的。

en: Asked to be released from a contract we could not complete.
zh: 我请求他们解除一份我们无法完成的合同。

en: And then asked that they still pay us.
zh: 然后又请求他们仍然把钱付给我们。

en: Without the money, NVIDIA would vaporize.
zh: 没有那笔钱，英伟达就会彻底消失。

en: It was embarrassing, humiliating, and one of the hardest things I have ever done.
zh: 那很尴尬，很丢脸，也是我这辈子做过的最艰难的事情之一。

en: And Sega's CEO, Irimajiri-san, said yes.
zh: 而Sega的CEO入交先生答应了。

en: I learned early that being CEO is not about power.
zh: 我很早就明白，做CEO并不是关于权力。

en: but the responsibility that comes with keeping the company alive.
zh: 而是关于让公司活下去所承担的责任。

en: And that honesty and humility can be met with generosity and kindness even in business.
zh: 我也明白，即使在商业世界里，诚实和谦卑也可能换来慷慨与善意。

en: We used the money to reset the company, and out of desperation,
zh: 我们用那笔钱重启了公司，也是在绝境之中，

en: we invented new ways of designing chips and computers that we still use today.
zh: 我们发明了新的芯片和计算机设计方法，而这些方法我们今天仍在使用。

en: For 33 years, NVIDIA had reinvented itself over and over again, each time asking,
zh: 33年来，英伟达一次又一次地重塑自己，每一次都在问：

en: how hard can it be?
zh: 这能有多难呢？

en: And each time learning, it's harder than we thought.
zh: 而每一次又都学到：它比我们想象的更难。

en: But through those experiences, we learned never to see failure as the opposite of success.
zh: 但通过这些经历，我们学会了永远不要把失败看成成功的反面。

en: Each failure is just another learning moment, a humility moment, a character-strengthening moment.
zh: 每一次失败，都只是一次学习的时刻，一次学会谦卑的时刻，一次锤炼品格的时刻。

en: The resilience forged through setbacks is what gives you the strength to go again.
zh: 挫折锻造出的韧性，正是让你重新出发的力量。

en: Today, I am one of the longest-serving CEOs in technology.
zh: 今天，我是科技行业任期最长的CEO之一。

en: NVIDIA, the body of work I share with 45,000 extraordinary colleagues is my life's work.
zh: 英伟达，是我与45,000位非凡同事共同完成的事业，也是我毕生的事业。

en: Now it's your time to realize your dreams.
zh: 现在，轮到你们去实现自己的梦想了。

en: and the timing could not be more perfect.
zh: 而这个时机再完美不过。

en: My career started at the beginning of the PC revolution.
zh: 我的职业生涯始于个人电脑革命的开端。

en: Your career starts at the beginning of the AI revolution.
zh: 你们的职业生涯始于人工智能革命的开端。

en: I cannot imagine a more exciting time to work, to begin your life's work.
zh: 我想象不出还有比现在更令人兴奋的时刻，去工作，去开启你们毕生的事业。

en: AI started right here at Carnegie Mellon.
zh: 人工智能正是从这里，从卡内基梅隆开始的。

en: I've heard countless AI jokes in the last 24 hours here at Carnegie Mellon.
zh: 过去24小时里，我在卡内基梅隆听到了无数个关于AI的笑话。

en: Carnegie Mellon is one of the true birthplaces of artificial intelligence and robotics.
zh: 卡内基梅隆是真正的人工智能和机器人技术发源地之一。

en: In the 1950s, researchers here created the Logic Theorist.
zh: 20世纪50年代，这里的研究人员创造了逻辑理论家。

en: widely recognized and considered the first AI computer program.
zh: 它被广泛认可并认为是第一个人工智能计算机程序。

en: In 1979, Carnegie Mellon founded the Robotics Institute.
zh: 1979年，卡内基梅隆创立了机器人研究所。

en: This morning, I visited with RoboClub.
zh: 今天早上，我还见到了机器人俱乐部的同学们。

en: the first academic institute devoted entirely to robotics.
zh: 这是第一个完全致力于机器人技术的学术机构。

en: Artificial intelligence has gone on now to reinvent computing completely.
zh: 如今，人工智能已经开始彻底重塑计算。

en: I have lived through every major computing platform shift.
zh: 我经历过每一次重大的计算平台转变。

en: mainframes, PCs, the internet, mobile, and cloud.
zh: 大型机、个人电脑、互联网、移动设备，以及云计算。

en: Each wave built on the one before.
zh: 每一波浪潮都建立在前一波的基础之上。

en: Each expanded access, each transformed industries and society.
zh: 每一波都扩大了使用门槛，每一波都改变了产业和社会。

en: but what is about to happen now is bigger than anything before.
zh: 但接下来即将发生的事，比以往任何一次都更大。

en: Computing is undergoing a complete reset, not since modern computing was first invented.
zh: 计算正在经历一次彻底重置，这是自现代计算诞生以来从未有过的。

en: For 60 years, computing worked the same way.
zh: 60年来，计算的运行方式一直相同。

en: Humans wrote software, computers executed instructions.
zh: 人类编写软件，计算机执行指令。

en: That paradigm is over.
zh: 这个范式已经结束了。

en: Artificial intelligence has reinvented computing.
zh: 人工智能重新发明了计算。

en: from human coding to machine learning.
zh: 从人类编程，转向机器学习。

en: from software running on CPUs to neural networks running on GPUs.
zh: 从运行在CPU上的软件，转向运行在GPU上的神经网络。

en: and from following instructions to understanding, reasoning, planning, and using tools.
zh: 从遵循指令，转向理解、推理、规划和使用工具。

en: A new industry has emerged to manufacture intelligence at scale.
zh: 一个大规模制造智能的新产业已经出现。

en: Because intelligence is foundational to every industry, every industry will change.
zh: 因为智能是每一个行业的基础，所以每一个行业都会发生变化。

en: For many, AI creates uncertainty.
zh: 对许多人来说，AI带来了不确定性。

en: People see AI writing software, generating images, driving cars.
zh: 人们看到AI编写软件、生成图像、驾驶汽车。

en: and naturally wonder what happens next.
zh: 自然会想，接下来会发生什么。

en: Will jobs disappear? Will people be left behind?
zh: 工作会消失吗？人们会被抛在后面吗？

en: Will this technology become too powerful?
zh: 这项技术会变得过于强大吗？

en: Every major technological revolution in history created fear alongside opportunity.
zh: 历史上每一次重大的技术革命，都在带来机会的同时带来了恐惧。

en: When society engages technology openly, responsibly, and optimistically.
zh: 当社会以开放、负责、乐观的方式拥抱技术时，

en: we expand human potential far more than we diminish it.
zh: 我们扩大的人类潜能，远远多于我们削弱的部分。

en: So first and above all, we must be clear-eyed.
zh: 所以，首先，也是最重要的，我们必须保持清醒。

en: Artificial intelligence, the automation of understanding, reasoning, and problem-solving.
zh: 人工智能，也就是对理解、推理和解决问题的自动化，

en: is one of the most powerful technologies humanity has ever created.
zh: 是人类有史以来创造出的最强大技术之一。

en: And like every transformative technology before it, it will bring both great promise and real risks.
zh: 而像它之前每一项变革性技术一样，它既会带来巨大的希望，也会带来真实的风险。

en: The responsibility of our generation is not only to advance AI, but to advance it wisely.
zh: 我们这一代人的责任，不只是推动AI发展，而是要明智地推动它发展。

en: Scientists and engineers have a profound responsibility to advance AI capabilities and AI safety together.
zh: 科学家和工程师肩负着深远的责任，要同时推动AI能力和AI安全的发展。

en: Policymakers. Policymakers have a responsibility to create thoughtful guardrails that protect society
zh: 政策制定者。政策制定者有责任建立深思熟虑的护栏，保护社会，

en: while still allowing innovation, discovery, and progress to move forward.
zh: 同时仍然允许创新、发现和进步继续向前。

en: History shows that societies that retreat from technology do not stop progress.
zh: 历史表明，选择逃避技术的社会，并不能阻止进步。

en: They only surrender the opportunity to shape it and to benefit from it.
zh: 它们只是放弃了塑造进步并从中受益的机会。

en: So the answer is not the fear of the future.
zh: 所以答案不是害怕未来。

en: The answer is to guide it wisely, build it responsibly.
zh: 答案是明智地引导未来，负责任地建设未来。

en: and ensure that it benefits reach as many people as possible.
zh: 并确保它带来的好处能够惠及尽可能多的人。

en: We should not teach fear of the future.
zh: 我们不应该教人们害怕未来。

en: We should engage it with optimism, responsibility, and ambition.
zh: 我们应该以乐观、责任和雄心去参与未来。

en: Only a fraction of the people in the world know how to write software.
zh: 世界上只有一小部分人懂得如何编写软件。

en: Now, anyone can ask AI to build something useful.
zh: 现在，任何人都可以请求AI去构建有用的东西。

en: A shopkeeper can create a website and grow a business.
zh: 一位店主可以创建一个网站，发展自己的生意。

en: A carpenter can design a kitchen and offer new services to clients.
zh: 一位木匠可以设计厨房，并为客户提供新的服务。

en: The AI writes the code.
zh: AI会编写代码。

en: Everyone is now a programmer.
zh: 现在，每个人都是程序员。

en: For the first time, the power of computing and intelligence can truly reach everyone and close the technology divide.
zh: 计算和智能的力量第一次真正能够触达每一个人，并弥合技术鸿沟。

en: The first time, and like electricity and the internet before it.
zh: 这是第一次，而且就像它之前的电力和互联网一样。

en: AI will require trillions of dollars of infrastructure investment.
zh: AI将需要数万亿美元的基础设施投资。

en: This is the largest technology infrastructure build out in human history.
zh: 这是人类历史上规模最大的技术基础设施建设。

en: and a once in a generation opportunity to re-industrialize America and restore the nation's capacity to build.
zh: 也是一次一代人只有一次的机会，让美国重新工业化，恢复这个国家的建设能力。

en: To support AI, America will build chip factories, computer factories, data centers,
zh: 为了支持AI，美国将在全国各地建设芯片工厂、计算机工厂、数据中心，

en: and advanced manufacturing facilities across the country.
zh: 以及先进制造设施。

en: AI gives America the opportunity to build again.
zh: AI给了美国重新建设的机会。

en: Electricians, plumbers, iron workers, technicians, builders, this is your time.
zh: 电工、管道工、钢铁工人、技术人员、建筑工人，现在是你们的时代。

en: AI is not just creating a new computing industry, it is creating a new industrial era.
zh: AI不只是在创造一个新的计算产业，它正在创造一个新的工业时代。

en: Powering this new infrastructure will require enormous amounts of energy.
zh: 驱动这套新基础设施，将需要巨大的能源。

en: But it is also driving one of the largest investments in energy infrastructure in generations,
zh: 但它也正在推动几代人以来最大规模的能源基础设施投资之一，

en: modernizing the grid, expanding power generation, and accelerating sustainable energy.
zh: 推动电网现代化，扩大电力生产，并加速可持续能源的发展。

en: And yes, AI will change every job.
zh: 没错，AI将改变每一份工作。

en: But the task and the purpose of a job are not the same.
zh: 但一份工作的任务和使命，并不是同一回事。

en: Many tasks will be automated.
zh: 许多任务将会被自动化。

en: Some jobs will disappear.
zh: 一些工作会消失。

en: But many new jobs and entire new industries will be created.
zh: 但许多新的工作，甚至全新的行业，也将被创造出来。

en: Software coding tasks are increasingly automated.
zh: 软件编码任务正越来越多地被自动化。

en: But using AI, software engineers can expand the search for solutions.
zh: 但借助AI，软件工程师能够扩大寻找解决方案的范围。

en: allowing them to tackle far more ambitious challenges.
zh: 从而让他们能够应对更加雄心勃勃的挑战。

en: Analyzing radiology scans is increasingly automated.
zh: 分析放射影像扫描正越来越多地被自动化。

en: But using AI, radiologists are elevated to better diagnose disease and care for patients.
zh: 但借助AI，放射科医生会被提升到更高层次，更好地诊断疾病、照护患者。

en: AI does not replace human purpose.
zh: AI不会取代人类的使命。

en: It amplifies human capability.
zh: 它会放大人类的能力。

en: That is why, even as AI writes more code and analyzes more scans,
zh: 这就是为什么，即使AI编写更多代码、分析更多影像扫描，

en: demand for software engineers and radiologists continue to grow.
zh: 对软件工程师和放射科医生的需求仍在持续增长。

en: AI is not likely to replace you.
zh: AI不太可能取代你。

en: But someone using AI better than you might.
zh: 但比你更会使用AI的人，可能会取代你。

en: So a good thought experiment is this.
zh: 所以，一个很好的思想实验是这样的。

en: Do we want our children to be supercharged by AI?
zh: 我们希望自己的孩子被AI大幅增强吗？

en: Or be left behind by those who are?
zh: 还是被那些已经被AI增强的人抛在后面？

en: No parent wants their child left behind.
zh: 没有哪位父母希望自己的孩子被落下。

en: So let us build AI safely.
zh: 所以，让我们安全地建设AI。

en: Let us also imagine an optimistic future.
zh: 也让我们想象一个乐观的未来。

en: One our children are excited to be part of, inspired to help build.
zh: 一个让我们的孩子兴奋地参与其中，并受到鼓舞去共同建设的未来。

en: So we can and must do four things at once.
zh: 所以，我们能够也必须同时做四件事。

en: Advance safely, create thoughtful policies, make AI broadly accessible, and encourage everyone to engage.
zh: 安全地推进AI，制定深思熟虑的政策，让AI广泛可及，并鼓励每个人参与其中。

en: Everyone should have AI.
zh: 每个人都应该拥有AI。

en: Opportunity should not belong only to the people who can code.
zh: 机会不应该只属于会写代码的人。

en: Class of 2026, you are entering the world at an extraordinary moment.
zh: 2026届毕业生们，你们正在一个非凡的时刻进入这个世界。

en: A new industry is being born.
zh: 一个新的产业正在诞生。

en: A new era of science and discovery is beginning.
zh: 一个科学与发现的新时代正在开始。

en: AI will accelerate the expansion of human knowledge and help solve problems once beyond our reach.
zh: AI将加速人类知识的扩展，并帮助我们解决曾经遥不可及的问题。

en: We have the opportunity to close the technology divide.
zh: 我们有机会弥合技术鸿沟。

en: and bring the power of computing and intelligence to billions of people for the very first time.
zh: 并第一次把计算和智能的力量带给数十亿人。

en: To re-industrialize America and restore our capacity to build.
zh: 让美国重新工业化，并恢复我们的建设能力。

en: And to help create a future more abundant, more capable and more hopeful than the world you inherited.
zh: 帮助创造一个比你们继承的世界更加富足、更有能力、也更充满希望的未来。

en: No generation has entered the world with more powerful tools or greater opportunities than you.
zh: 没有哪一代人在进入世界时，拥有比你们更强大的工具和更巨大的机会。

en: We are all standing at the same starting line.
zh: 我们都站在同一条起跑线上。

en: This is your moment to help shape what comes next.
zh: 现在，就是你们帮助塑造未来的时刻。

en: So run, don't walk.
zh: 所以，奔跑吧，不要慢慢走。

en: Carnegie Mellon has a motto I love.
zh: 卡内基梅隆有一句我很喜欢的校训。

en: My heart is in the work.
zh: 吾心安于此业。

en: So put your heart in the work.
zh: 所以，把你们的心投入到事业中。

en: Build something worthy of your education, your potential.
zh: 去创造一些无愧于你们所受教育、无愧于你们潜力的东西。

en: and the people who believed in you long before the world did.
zh: 也无愧于那些早在世界相信你们之前，就已经相信你们的人。

en: Congratulations Carnegie Mellon class of 2026.
zh: 祝贺卡内基梅隆大学2026届毕业生。
